groundTruth.note: No head is scored against an independent random draw. Every truth label is a deterministic property of its generator family, so the Stage 2L.11 failure mode is absent — but the labels are construction intent, not independently derived world state, and are classified as such.

degeneracy.note: Effective sample size counts generator families, not variants, because a family whose prediction never varies across its variants supplies one independent observation. Certifying from nominal counts would report an effective three as three hundred.

stressReport.note: Cases are dropped when the label is not unambiguously true of the series actually produced — including any series that saturates at the range bound. A first draft scored a clamped, flattened reversal tail as a head error; that was a generator bug, and this filter exists so it cannot recur.

identifiability.note: This head has no wrong cases on at least one of DEVELOPMENT and CALIBRATION, so an AUROC over correctness is undefined rather than at chance. Reported as not measurable; it is NOT evidence that the head cannot predict its own correctness.

revalidation.note: This corpus scores temporal labels, not actions, so it can contradict the inherited certification but cannot by itself establish a Prime-relative harmful-change rate.

collisions.note: Fewer than two heads are delegation eligible, so no overlapping delegation can arise and the inherited Arbiter path is unchanged.

portfolio.combinedCoverageNote: Seven of the eight heads emit temporal labels, not actions, so there is no action-level error they can be said to cover. Only the direction head has a certified action-delegation path, and its coverage is the Stage 2L.10 certified figure.

limitationDetail: Only 1 of 8 heads (direction) has an action-delegation path; the assembly sets actionMapping=false and forbids action fields, so the other 7 emit temporal labels and have no delegation to be safe or unsafe about.
2 head(s) cannot be scored at all against the current benchmark because they emit labels it does not expect: persistence (unreachable: NOT_PERSISTENT); timeToThreshold (unreachable: CROSSING_1_TO_3).

2 head(s) were measured against a search-space-matched, Bonferroni-corrected null and did not separate materially; 3 produced no wrong case on a measurable split, so their self-correctness AUROC is undefined rather than at chance and is reported as not measurable, not as non-identifiable.
interpretation.remediationNote: Stage 2L.19 is a characterization stage and the brief forbids remediating weak heads here. The defects are identified and stopped at.

portabilityNote: Stage 2L.10 through 2L.18 remain DIGEST_PRODUCED_SINGLE_PLATFORM. Stage 2L.19 does not change that.
